title.narrative: Providing multi-sectoral assistance to Burua Technical Institute in Somaliland

description.narrative: - Rehabilitation and expansion of educational facilities at Burao Technical Institute. - 150) Young people benefiting from vocational training. - (20) beneficiaries of the training of trainers activity. - (50) young people benefited from participating in business centers. ​- Establishing (4) agricultural greenhouses and (400) farmers benefiting from training on good agricultural practices.

1- Developing infrastructure and building the capabilities of Burao Technical Institute. 2- Increase access to technical, vocational and entrepreneurship skills training for youth from target population groups in Somaliland.
Providing access to functional vocational training to equip youth with the necessary skills to improve their livelihoods through the rehabilitation of Burao Technical Institute
